historyHint: The latest 50 requests for this device. Open a request to follow its progress.
emptyHint: Choose a supported command above to request information from this device.
unavailable: Command status could not be refreshed. Try again.
expiry: Wait for a connection for up to {seconds} seconds
technicalHint: Original references and protocol evidence for troubleshooting.
auditHint: Requests currently use the development demo audit identity.
closeHint: Closing this window does not cancel the request. Reopen it from command history.
waitingHint: Waiting for an eligible device connection. This request is saved and will remain in history.
sendingHint: The request is being sent. Waiting for the device's reply.
acknowledgedHint: The device confirmed the command. This is not independent verification of execution; review the information received.
rejectedHint: The device rejected the command. Check the device and the recorded reason before requesting it again.
failedHint: The request failed. Review the reason and the device connection before creating a new request.
expiredHint: The request expired before it could be sent. You can deliberately create a new request when the device is available.
cancelledHint: The waiting request was cancelled before sending.
unknownHint: The outcome is unknown. Check the device or read its state before deciding whether to create another request. It will not be resent automatically.
unknownOutcome: Result not recognised; inspect technical details.
unknownReason: The recorded reason is not recognised. Its original code is available in technical details.

outcomes.RESPONSE_RECEIVED: Device response received; inspect the result

reasons.SUBMISSION_INTERRUPTED: Sending was interrupted; the request may have reached the device.
reasons.REQUEST_EXPIRED: The device did not become available before expiry.
reasons.TARGET_CHANGED: The device assignment or identity changed before sending.
reasons.OPERATOR_CANCELLED: An operator cancelled this request before it was sent.
reasons.GATEWAY_REFUSED: The device was busy or was not connected through its primary connection.
reasons.SUBMISSION_FAILED: Sending failed or timed out; the device may have received the request.
reasons.REPLY_TIMEOUT: No reply arrived within the response window.
reasons.TRANSPORT_FAILED: The connection failed while sending the request.
